notes: A room case is Character::Registry#slots for one room of a story whose races are written as [name, monstrous] in `races`, holding nobody yet: one slot per person drawn, each {race, age, sex}. A generator case is Character::Generator's draws with rng = Roll.generator(story:, sequence:, kind: CAST) (sequence is the story's character count): race, age and sex, then attractiveness, born_in and raised_by.
